entities.name: Juris Štāls
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juris Štāls is a Latvian former ice hockey player. He last as a right wing for HK Kurbads of Latvian Hockey Higher League. He was drafted in the ninth round of the 2001 NHL Entry Draft by the New York Rangers. He has also played for the Latvian national ice hockey team at the 2014 Winter Olympics.
